observations.comparison_limit: Approximate 5.28x runtime difference (2185.102/413.736), not a controlled benchmark: Windows log is a different revision and reports 1085 cases with 3 errors/28 skips; mac supported-path log has 1087 cases, 11 skips and passed. Windows verbose timestamps give completion intervals; the local Mac log has no per-test timestamps. Neither log proves physical disk writes or attributes time to a Python function.

slow_test_examples.coverage: Builds a five-unit dependency sequence, validates the release with historical completion views, bounds repeated historical_checker calls within one check, then mutates evidence and requires fresh validation to block.
Four interrupted retry/capture/continuation cycles exercise operation-scoped Checker reuse and reject reuse of the oldest attempt ID.
Tests both construction and acceptance-check dependency paths, alters evidence after completion, and requires dependent history/release to become stale.
Multiple attempt/continuation cycles ensure a reopened finding can close while prior immutable closure bytes remain unchanged.
Tests source/environment drift, revalidation requirement, and preserving implementation bytes.

source_analysis.fixture_io: UnitHistoryTests.setUpClass copies the skills tree once to construct a frozen predecessor checker; tests/test_unit_history.py:30-40 then uses isolated synthetic Project fixtures via UnitExecutionTests.setUp and tests/test_sdd_check.py:23. This is class-level setup, not repeated product-checkout copying. The frozen checker computes a whole-skill toolchain identity, so removing surrounding fixture files without proving the predecessor contract could invalidate the test.

assessment.conclusion: No duplicate coverage or safely droppable test was demonstrated. The longest observed gaps correspond to distinct recovery invariants: historical validation cache scope, retry identity, stale dependency invalidation, immutable finding closure, and source/environment revalidation. Removing or combining them risks losing independent regression evidence.
assessment.safe_next_step: Add non-mutating per-test duration telemetry at unittest TestResult startTest/stopTest in a future unchanged full-suite run, first on Windows, and keep the complete suite and all assertions. Use that to separate Python/test work from runner overhead before attempting any fixture optimization. If profiling later confirms repeated work inside a single validation operation, optimize only the scoped implementation cache while retaining fresh validation on later calls.
verification_limits: No test suite rerun, profiler, Windows environment, provider, accounting DB, or source changes were used.
The completion gaps are log-derived approximations and include between-test/runner overhead; they do not identify exact function costs.
The three Windows failures were newline serialization cases in the older source revision and are unrelated to the runtime analysis; current source is at 5651687.
The supported Mac log is a different source revision and lacks per-test completion timestamps.
